meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 给项目加上 DeltaChat 渠道适配器:机器人用专属邮箱收发消息,走 Autocrypt/OpenPGP 端到端加密,支持收发文件附件。你在 DeltaChat 应用里打开邀请链接或扫二维码即可与机器人建立聊天。
howto.when: 当你要给项目添加 DeltaChat 渠道、配置它的邮箱凭据,或把 DeltaChat 聊天接到某个 agent 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 DeltaChat 渠道加到项目里
say.note: 会拉取适配器、安装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: DeltaChat 需要填哪些邮箱配置?
say.note: 列出 .env 里六项必填变量

say.text: 清掉 DeltaChat 的锁文件并重启服务

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel adapter: the bot sends and receives messages over a dedicated email account, encrypted end-to-end with Autocrypt/OpenPGP, with file attachments. You connect from the DeltaChat app via invite link or QR code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add DeltaChat as a channel, set up its email credentials, or wire a DeltaChat chat to an agent.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to my project
say_en.note: Fetches adapter, installs package, runs registration test

say_en.text: Which email settings does DeltaChat need?
Clear the DeltaChat lock file and restart the service
